english.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a literary verse piece.
Use this shorter form when the context focuses on poems or poetic writing rather than the genre label 詩歌.
詩 is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for poetry in general.

ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 ci2 se2 si1

examples.english: I loved reading Tang-dynasty verse when I was young.
